_note: v2.4 plan 01 guidance on a GENERATED checkpoint, LIVE (real expansion, real generation; so-scenario --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'). The fork stub is expanded by the real model (a failed/stale chain is regenerated up to three times, every attempt reported), a neutral real turn commits the boundary that merges it, then `/cp activate gen_fork_stub_1` makes the first generated checkpoint active and a real turn is sent. The request ST sends must carry that checkpoint's generated guidance (merge.ts copies beat.guidance), which is what 'source = the played, merged story' promises.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 50 }); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const probe = globalThis.__genGuidance = { requests: [] }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; const active = rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null; probe.requests.push({ active, guidance: rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.[active]?.guidance ?? null, body: JSON.stringify(data ?? null) }); }); return { recorder: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const tries = []; let entry = null; const settle = async () => { const end = Date.now() + 480000; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = Object.values(rt.getSnapshot().expansion?.entries ?? {}).find((candidate) => candidate.stubId === 'fork_stub') ?? null; if (found && ['validated','inserted','needs_review','failed','stale'].includes(found.status)) return found; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)); } return null; }; for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt += 1) { entry = await settle(); if (!entry) throw new Error('no settled expansion for fork_stub within 8 minutes: ' + JSON.stringify(tries)); tries.push({ attempt, status: entry.status }); if (['validated','inserted','needs_review'].includes(entry.status)) break; if (attempt === 3) throw new Error('three real generations and none merged: ' + JSON.stringify(tries)); if (!(await rt.expansions.regenerate(entry.key))) throw new Error('regenerate refused: ' + JSON.stringify(tries)); } const guidance = entry.beats.map((beat) => beat.guidance ?? null); if (!guidance[0]) throw new Error('the first generated beat carries no guidance, so this check measures nothing: ' + JSON.stringify(guidance)); globalThis.__genGuidance.beat0 = guidance[0]; return { status: entry.status, tries, guidance: guidance.map((text) => String(text ?? '').slice(0, 80)) };

send_generate.text: We take stock and check our gear before moving on.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const cp = rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.gen_fork_stub_1; if (!cp) throw new Error('the chain was not merged into the played story at the boundary: ' + JSON.stringify(Object.keys(rt.getStory()?.checkpointById ?? {}))); if (cp.guidance !== globalThis.__genGuidance.beat0) throw new Error('the merged checkpoint does not carry the beat guidance: ' + JSON.stringify({ merged: cp.guidance, beat: globalThis.__genGuidance.beat0 })); return { merged: true, guidance: String(cp.guidance).slice(0, 120) };

const value = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''; if (!value.includes(globalThis.__genGuidance.beat0)) throw new Error('the generated checkpoint guidance is not in the injected block: ' + JSON.stringify(value)); globalThis.__genGuidance.requests.length = 0; return { block: value.slice(0, 160) };

const probe = globalThis.__genGuidance; const onGenerated = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.active === 'gen_fork_stub_1'); if (!onGenerated.length) throw new Error('no request was built while the generated checkpoint was active: ' + JSON.stringify(probe.requests.map((r) => r.active))); const missing = onGenerated.filter((r) => !r.body.includes(probe.beat0)); if (missing.length) throw new Error('a request on the generated checkpoint does not carry its guidance'); return { requests: onGenerated.length, carried: true };
